title: Senior Capture Manager - UK
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is hiring a Senior Capture Manager (UK) to support our most complex, high-impact deals, with an initial focus on public sector opportunities.

This is not a traditional proposal writer or reactive Deal Desk role. The Senior Capture Manager will operate upstream in the sales cycle, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Legal, Security, and RevOps to shape deal strategy, influence decision criteria, and improve win probability before formal procurement begins.

This role exists to increase quality, speed, and consistency across complex deals — while reducing risk, rework, and late-stage friction.

What You’ll Do

Capture & Deal Strategy

  • Own capture strategy for PubSec opportunities globally and strategic public sector deals

  • Engage early in the sales cycle (pre-RFP where possible) to:

    • Shape requirements and evaluation criteria

    • Influence Statements of Work and procurement language

    • Align pricing, scope, and structure with long-term deal success

  • Act as a strategic advisor to AEs on deal positioning, ROMs, and proposal framing

Proposal Quality & Risk Management

  • Lead capture execution for complex opportunities:

    • Translate customer intent into compliant, outcome-driven proposals

    • Ensure responses accurately reflect customer needs, constraints, and procurement realities

  • Reduce late-stage surprises by identifying risk early and guiding teams through mitigation strategies

Cross-Functional Orchestration

  • Serve as a central point of coordination across:

    • Sales

    • Product & Engineering

    • Legal

    • Security & IT

    • Finance & RevOps

  • Triage what requires escalation vs. what can be resolved within Deal Desk

  • Ensure the right teams are engaged at the right time — no earlier, no later

Enablement & Continuous Improvement

  • Build reusable capture templates, artifacts, and best practices

  • Codify learnings from wins and losses to improve future deal execution

  • Become a subject-matter expert in how TRM wins public sector deals

What Success in the Role Looks Like

  • Deals are shaped earlier, not rescued later

  • Proposals reflect buyer intent, outcomes, and procurement realities

  • Sales experiences faster momentum and fewer blockers

  • Proposal quality improves without sacrificing speed

  • Win rates increase for complex public sector opportunities

Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years experience in capture, deal strategy, or complex enterprise/public sector sales support

  • Proven experience influencing outcomes before RFPs are finalized

  • Background supporting complex, bespoke software or data platforms

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to operate calmly across multiple high-stakes, concurrent deals

About the Team:

  • The RevOps team is truly remote! We practice async communication and collaboration through various methods such as slack channels and documentation (Notion, etc.). It's important to note that the primary method for communication for this role with all relevant stakeholders will be through slack (text, voice notes and video messages across DMs and various channels). Additionally, RevOps is involved in a variety of live recurring meetings throughout the week (~8 hours). A few times a year we'll come together in-person to collaborate, with an opportunity to engage in-person more often if you're near a hub.

TRM Speed

  • BI & Reporting Infrastructure: Built and deployed a fully automated BI dashboard in Looker within one week, reducing GTM reporting time by 60% and enabling real-time insights for leadership.

  • Tech Stack & Automation: Optimized Salesforce workflows and integrated CPQ automation in under 48 hours, eliminating manual data entry and accelerating deal approvals by 3x.

  • Revenue Planning & Strategy: Led a full-scale territory realignment in just three days, ensuring seamless execution and zero downtime for the sales team while improving coverage efficiency.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at T

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

AlphaSense’s Design team is a strategic driver of product differentiation, shaping how the world’s leading companies make high-stakes decisions with confidence. We believe great UX is not just about usability—it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.

As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows—from search to synthesis to decision-making. We partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex data and advanced AI capabilities into cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality experiences.

Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Product Designer to join our growing team and play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a Staff-level individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through design craft, systems thinking, and a deep understanding of our customers’ workflows.

In this role, you will drive strategic design initiatives—translating complex, data-rich problems into intuitive, high-quality experiences that feel tailored to how our customers actually work. You’ll bring clarity to ambiguity, define end-to-end workflows, and ensure our product experiences are cohesive, scalable, and grounded in real user needs.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to shape how capabilities come together into meaningful user experiences — from early concept through execution. You’ll balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints, ensuring we deliver experiences that are not only functional, but differentiated through quality and usability.

description:
About AlphaSense:

With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

The Core Cloud Platform team is responsible for AlphaSense's entire cloud infrastructure, including AWS account management, networking, data storages, and Kubernetes clusters. We build the underlying platform that supports hundreds of services and is used by over 400 globally distributed engineers.

We're scaling into a cell-based architecture, and the number of cells we run is growing fast, taking our Kubernetes footprint from dozens of clusters toward hundreds. That takes the platform in three directions at once: infrastructure configuration becomes a first-class layer with its own lifecycle, independent of application code; provisioning a new cell becomes a days-long automated operation rather than a multi-week effort; and cross-cell control points become standard, reusable, and consistent everywhere.

This is a Principal Engineer role with real breadth within the cloud platform. You'll set the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform as it scales with AlphaSense's growth, and take dedicated ownership of the cloud-side configuration and Helm chart layer that every service depends on. Data storages are a critical part of this surface, and we're looking for genuine depth there.

It requires a deep cloud of both operational and software development skills, the ability to lead ambitious technical programmes, and the credibility to set direction with Engineering leaders and very senior engineers across dozens of teams.

We're looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI tooling in their day-to-day work, appreciates the productivity value it brings, and is motivated to make our infrastructure ever-more AI friendly.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the architectural roadmap for our cloud, Kubernetes, and storage platform
  • Own cloud-side configuration and the Helm chart layer for Cloud Core
  • Build the cell registry and automate provisioning to take new cell setup from weeks to days
  • Design the cross-cell gate mechanism as the reusable standard checkpoint across every cell
  • Own, operate and evolve our Cloud and Kubernetes platform, including our data storage layers
  • Make operations (upgrades, patching, lifecycle management) routine across hundreds of clusters
  • Continuously improve the security, reliability, cost efficiency and performance of our infrastructure
  • Champion standards and drive initiatives to promote uniformisation and eliminate duplication
  • Enable truly self-service and agentic workflow patterns that support a Build it - Own it model
  • Build tooling and AI powered integrations that reduce the cognitive load in cloud
  • Architect, design and implement simple and maintainable solutions

Who You Are:

  • Extremely experienced in Kubernetes and its various components, containerisation and AWS cloud
  • Proven track record of running Kubernetes and Cloud based production SaaS systems at scale
  • Experience operating Kubernetes as a large fleet with hundreds of clusters
  • Strong knowledge of data storages across SQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch
  • Strong operational and troubleshooting skill with Kubernetes, databases and messaging systems
  • Deep understanding of networking and production level usage of service meshes and gateways
  • Experience separating infrastructure configuration from application code at scale
  • Experience with cell-based, multi-tenant or multi-region architectures
  • Proficiency in Python and Golang
  • Evangelist of highly performant CI/CD practices that are supportive of agentic workflows
  • Ability and desire to design, lead, influence and deliver on ambitious technical roadmaps

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Vespa
  • Automated provisioning of new environments, regions or cells end-to-end
  • Management of large fleets of Kubernetes clusters with lifecycle management tools
  • Production usage of Hashicorp Vault or similar secret management systems

title: Director Commercial Legal, EMEA
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

We are seeking a UK-based Director, Commercial Legal to lead Veeam’s EMEA Commercial Legal team, supporting our fast-paced sales organization. Reporting to the Senior Director, Commercial Legal, based in the UK, you will lead a team of four to five lawyers while remaining a key individual contributor.

This highly visible, hands-on leadership role combines team oversight with direct involvement in complex software transactions. You will serve as the team’s escalation point while negotiating and closing strategic deals. The ideal candidate is an experienced technology commercial lawyer and proven people leader who thrives in a collaborative environment and stays closely connected to the business.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with your US counterpart to drive consistency across contracting positions, templates, playbooks, and processes, while sharing knowledge, best practices, and workload across regions.
  • Negotiate and close a significant portfolio of complex, high-value agreements, including software, SaaS, BaaS, professional services, and channel transactions, partnering directly with Sales, Deal Desk, and other key stakeholders.
  • Provide clear, practical, and commercially focused legal advice, balancing legal, regulatory, privacy, and commercial considerations with the needs of the business.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the EMEA Commercial Legal team, setting clear expectations, supporting professional growth, and addressing performance or people matters promptly and constructively.
  • Build strong partnerships with Sales and sales leadership, developing a clear understanding of pipeline and business priorities to ensure the team has visibility across transactions and focuses resources where they will have the greatest impact.
  • Develop and deliver training and practical guidance that enables Sales and other stakeholders to navigate contracting processes effectively and efficiently.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex, high-risk, or novel commercial matters, providing guidance while empowering team members to maintain ownership, and keeping Commercial Legal leadership informed of significant matters, emerging trends, and resourcing needs.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative culture across the global Commercial Legal team and champion continuous improvement in how the team operates, partners with the business, and delivers results.

What You’ll Bring

  • Qualified solicitor in England and Wales, holding a current practising certificate, with 12+ years of post-qualification experience gained at a leading law firm and/or in-house, including significant in-house experience within a software or technology company.
  • Proven people leadership experience, with a track record of managing, coaching, and developing lawyers.
  • Extensive hands-on experience negotiating and closing complex software and SaaS agreements in a fast-paced sales environment, with a desire to remain actively involved in transactions.
  • Exceptional drafting and negotiation skills, with demonstrated experience partnering closely with Sales and other business stakeholders in the technology sector.
  • Experience advising on privacy and data protection matters arising in commercial technology transactions.
  • You will be a collaborative, team-oriented leader who views success as shared, contributes effectively as part of a broader leadership team, and brings a global perspective beyond their own region.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the confidence to make pragmatic, risk-based decisions, including in situations where there may be limited precedent.
  • Flexible, creative, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to balance the needs of Sales with appropriate legal and business risk, while exercising sound judgment on when to escalate.
  • A credible and supportive leader who leads by example, effectively balancing a significant personal caseload with team leadership as business priorities evolve.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to simplify complex legal issues, provide clear and practical guidance, and challenge stakeholders constructively.

What you'll get

  • 25 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment
  • Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection
  • Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary
  • Defined contribution pension plan with employer match
  • Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents
  • Employee Assistance Program with therapy, legal, and financial support, plus online GP services and wellbeing programs
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

title: Head of Bids
description:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// Every city we win begins with a bid. As Head of Bids, you'll lead the team behind them, creating compelling tenders, from qualification through to submission, clarifications and award, for transit agencies and operators internationally.

This role sits at the centre of how Masabi wins new business. Business Development, Product, Engineering, Services, Legal and Finance all feed into a bid. Your team shapes their input into one answer, built around what the agency has asked for and how they will evaluate it, with the business and technical strategy to match. You will own the pricing and commercial strategy behind it and run the governance that helps the business make the right call at each stage.

You will also build the function itself: the people, the process and the content the team relies on to bid well under real deadlines. Using AI to make the team faster and sharper is part of that, so we win more often in the markets we care about most.

Location_

// This role is available on a remote basis for candidates located anywhere in the UK. Candidates based in London may also work in a hybrid model, with occasional travel to the office.

Responsibilities_

  • Lead each bid from qualification through to submission and award, partnering closely with BD and keeping the team on top of quality and deadlines

  • Own the pricing and commercial strategy behind every bid, balancing the chance of winning against margin

  • Run the governance that helps the business make the right call at each stage, including which opportunities to pursue and which to let go

  • Share bid risk and recommendations openly with senior leadership, including where the risk is uncomfortable

  • Bring colleagues together across Product, Engineering, Services, Legal and Finance so the technical, commercial and legal content reads as one answer

  • Build the function itself: the people, processes, content and tooling, including AI that the team relies on to move faster and win more often

  • Plan resourcing across live bids, matching the right people and expertise to each one

  • Support, coach and develop the bids team and help each person grow

  • Build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners, so what we submit reflects what customers genuinely need

About You_

  • You have helped win high-value, competitive bids, and you care about the quality of what goes out the door

  • Leading a bids or proposals team is familiar ground, including the process and governance around it

  • Pricing strategy is something you can build and explain, including the call you made between winning and margin

  • Presenting bid risk to senior leadership does not worry you, including when the recommendation is to walk away

  • Sales and procurement both make sense to you, from either side of the table

  • Several bids running at once is normal, and the detail stays accurate when deadlines are tight

  • You communicate clearly and can bring contributors together across teams, time zones and countries

  • Disagreement gets handled with respect, and you can bring a debate to a decision

  • AI is part of how you work, not something you tolerate as a bolt-on

  • Developing people is something you enjoy, and your feedback tends to land

Nice To Have_

  • Familiarity with public procurement for technology solutions

  • Experience in public transport, mobility, or another regulated, tender-led sector

  • Additional languages, given the range of markets we bid into

  • Experience introducing or improving bid tooling, content libraries or knowledge management

AI at Masabi_

As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement.
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together.

 That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

 We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative , a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

 Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

 You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

 You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

 What you’ll do

 In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

• Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.

• Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.

• Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.

• Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.

• Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.

• Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.

• Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.

• Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.

• Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

 What you’ll bring

• A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.

• Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.

• A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.

• Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.

• Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.

• Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

 What success looks like

 A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

 Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

 Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.

title: Senior Staff Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 About the Team:

 Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes.

 We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer.

 What You'll Do:

• Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests

• Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean

• Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations

• Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment

• Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked

• Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful

• Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them

• Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities

• Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it

 What You'll Bring:

• 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes

• Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention

• Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes

• Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know

• Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time

• An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster

• A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment

• Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable

 This Role is a Great Fit If:

• You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into

• You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product

• You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue

• You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem

• You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it

• You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made

• You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity

• You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced

 Applying

 Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

 When applying please include:

 A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts.

 Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Business Continuity Management Lead
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 About the Role

 Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership.

 This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams.

 The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience.

 Key Responsibilities

• Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise BCM framework, policies, standards, governance, and operating model, with a prioritized implementation roadmap aligned to bank-launch readiness and critical services.

• Partner with business owners to identify critical services, conduct business impact analyses (customer, financial, operational, and regulatory), and map dependencies across people, processes, technology, facilities, and third parties, including single points of failure.

• Establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), where applicable, with business and technology owners; challenge gaps between objectives and recovery capabilities.

• Set standards for continuity plans and recovery procedures, and facilitate and support accountable owners in developing actionable plans and alternative operating arrangements.

• Coordinate business continuity with technology disaster recovery, incident response, and crisis management, with clear activation criteria, escalation paths, and communications responsibilities.

• Design and lead a risk-based exercise program, from tabletop simulations to end-to-end recovery tests, and drive lessons learned, remediation tracking, and verification that gaps are closed.

• Partner with Third-Party Risk Management and vendor owners to assess critical provider recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements, and concentration dependencies.

• Embed continuity considerations into new products, material business changes, and technology implementations.

• Establish metrics and reporting that give management and relevant committees visibility into readiness, testing outcomes, material gaps, and overdue remediation.

• Build and lead a growing BCM team, including hiring and developing analysts as the program scales over the next year.

• Deliver role-based training and promote awareness of continuity responsibilities across the organization.

• Support regulatory examinations and bank-launch readiness reviews with accurate documentation and evidence of recovery capability.

 Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in business continuity management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or a related discipline within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment.

• Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing an enterprise BCM program, including governance, implementation, testing, and reporting.

• Strong skills in business impact analysis, critical-service identification, dependency mapping, and recovery objective development.

• Experience developing actionable continuity plans and leading exercises that test recovery assumptions and expose gaps.

• Sufficient technical fluency to work with Engineering on cloud services, system dependencies, data recovery, and technology disaster recovery.

• Working knowledge of third-party risk management, including assessing critical vendor recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements and concentration risk.

• Proven ability to drive cross-functional remediation through influence, with a clear view of where BCM oversight ends and business or technology ownership begins.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain readiness gaps and tradeoffs to senior leadership.

• Experience managing a team of Business Continuity analysts.

 Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with banking supervisory expectations for business continuity, and operational resilience.

• Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment.

• Familiarity with recognized continuity standards, such as ISO 22301, and BCM tools for plan management, exercises, and issue tracking.

• Relevant professional certification, such as CBCP or MBCI.

 Leadership Attributes

• Pragmatic, first-principles builder who turns ambiguous needs into clear priorities and designs a program that fits Mercury’s operations and scale.

• Takes ownership and follows through from identified gaps to demonstrated recovery.

• Collaborative, low-ego, and effective across the three lines of defense.

• Calm under pressure and able to facilitate clear decisions during disruptions.

• Able to challenge constructively, distinguish material gaps from theoretical concerns, and avoid over-engineering.

 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

 Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

description:

We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

The ideal candidate will be a versatile, self-driven, team-player who enjoys context-switching across high-profile initiatives, and is uniquely motivated by Roblox’s mission of connecting a billion people with optimism and civility. From serving as an external representative of Roblox with state and local law enforcement agencies, to collaborating cross-functionally with our Legal & Advocacy, Civility, Safety, Product, and Communications teams (among others), you will have a diverse set of responsibilities in furtherance of assisting law enforcement, educating external stakeholders such as parents and educators on digital safety, and ultimately helping keep users safe on Roblox.

 This position is remotely based in Kansas and will report to the Senior Manager of US Public Policy.

 Please note: This role requires On-Call support during weekends and holidays, and is expected to include frequent travel. The scope may also require reviewing graphic, controversial, and offensive content in accordance with Roblox’s handling policies.

 You Will:

• Develop and advance strategic law enforcement relationships with special focus on law enforcement in the State of Kansas, and Midwestern region, while assisting with global outreach as needed.

• Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement, including with the Kansas Attorney General’s Office

• Plan and execute educational programs for law enforcement agencies and other key external stakeholders (i.e. parent groups and educators) regarding Roblox’s platform safety efforts, including our law enforcement response policies and NCMEC CyberTip initiatives.

• Proactively identify, monitor, analyze, and internally advise on law enforcement developments affecting Roblox in the State of Kansas and Midwestern region.

• Seek to understand and empathetically respond to regional law enforcement concerns, while helping internally codify and scale resultant learnings.

• Listen to and understand the concerns of Kansas parents, caregivers, and educators regarding the safety of Roblox. You will provide guidance and education that empower these audiences and build confidence in Roblox’s emphasis on product and policy safety, which keeps users safe and healthy.

• Forge a deep subject-matter expertise of Roblox’s internal and external safety practices, so as to identify, advocate for, and help implement strategic safety enhancements.

• Draft professional work product – for both internal and external audiences – supported by clear, concise, and multi-sourced platform safety investigations.

• Collaborate and build strong internal relationships across our Legal & Advocacy, Safety, Product, and Communications teams (among others) to help address law enforcement emergencies, platform safety escalations, and comprehensive Roblox undertakings.

 You Have:

• 10+ years of work experience in law enforcement, intelligence, government, trust and safety, or an adjacent field.

• Detailed knowledge of the law enforcement community and related policymakers in the State of Kansas, and Midwestern region, along with current trends and challenges in online safety and policy (particularly child safety and regional-specific considerations).

• Enthusiasm for and a demonstrated track record of stellar public speaking, short-notice travel, building and maintaining constructive relationships, defining your own work processes, and adding organizational value no matter how small or large the task.

• Outstanding communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

• Agility to navigate ambiguity, resilience to overcome obstacles, and the internal drive to concurrently manage multiple high-profile, time-sensitive initiatives in a dynamic environment.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations, you’ll translate the Marketing Operations vision into a roadmap and independently drive it forward while partnering closely with Growth, RevOps, Data, Product, and other GTM teams.

 What You’ll Do

• Own our marketing automation platform end to end, including workflows, lifecycle stages, segmentation, forms, lists, email operations, data hygiene, deliverability, governance, and documentation.

• Build and maintain the connection between marketing automation, Salesforce, product data, and analytics so we can understand and engage users throughout the customer journey.

• Establish reliable attribution and measurement across marketing and product-led journeys, including UTM governance and connections between campaigns, signups, activation, conversion, and revenue.

• Build reporting and self-service dashboards that give Marketing and GTM partners a trusted view of performance and support weekly, monthly, and executive-level decision-making.

• Partner with Growth to operationalize lifecycle programs across email, in-product experiences, and sales-assist triggers, turning customer and product signals into scalable journeys from signup through activation and conversion.

• Build experimentation infrastructure that allows marketers to launch, measure, and learn from tests without requiring engineering support for every experiment.

• Own the operational health of the MarTech stack, including integrations, data flows, governance, vendor relationships, and periodic assessments of what we should keep, retire, consolidate, or integrate.

• Establish scalable practices for high-volume email operations, including audience management, domain and inbox health, deliverability, and safeguards that protect the customer experience.

• Turn large and sometimes ambiguous datasets into actionable recommendations, identifying points of friction or drop-off and partnering with Marketing, Growth, Product, Data, and RevOps on opportunities to improve conversion.

• Own the Marketing Operations portion of the broader Marketing budget and evaluate technology investments based on business value, scalability, and ROI.

• Explore emerging capabilities in AI-enabled marketing operations and AI visibility measurement, helping the team establish useful workflows and baselines as the space develops.

 What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or a closely related discipline, with experience operating independently in a complex B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment.

• Deep experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems such as HubSpot, Marketo, Eloqua, and Salesforce, including lifecycle stages, campaign architecture, attribution, lead or account routing, and data governance.

• Experience working with high-volume customer or prospect datasets and designing segmentation, lifecycle, and operational approaches that remain reliable at scale.

• Significant experience operating high-volume email programs, with a practical understanding of deliverability, domain and inbox reputation, audience management, warming strategies, and the risks that emerge at large sending volumes.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex datasets, identify meaningful patterns, question the quality of the underlying data, and turn findings into recommendations.

• Experience building or operating lifecycle, nurture, or in-product engagement programs tied to measurable activation or conversion outcomes.

• Systems thinking and experience designing integrations across marketing automation, CRM, product, analytics, and data systems.

• Experience building measurement and experimentation infrastructure that enables other teams to operate and learn independently.

• Strong GTM fluency and an understanding of how Marketing Operations, Growth, Sales, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success connect to customer experience and revenue.

• Comfort using AI-enabled tools and workflows to accelerate your work while applying judgment to validate outputs and determine where automation is (and isn’t) appropriate.

• Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Amplitude and experience with emerging AEO or AI-visibility tooling is helpful.

• Experience working with contractors, agencies, or distributed partners is helpful but not required.

• Familiarity with developer tools, web platforms, or another high-volume PLG business is useful, but we value relevant operating experience over category-specific expertise.

• You enjoy building the foundation, not just operating what someone else has already built. You’re energized by taking an imperfect system and creating something scalable, measurable, and trusted.

• You’re comfortable moving between architecture and execution. You can define how a system should work and then get into the details yourself when necessary to make it work.

• You thrive with significant autonomy. Given a goal and context, you investigate the problem, weigh tradeoffs, make a recommendation, and drive the work forward without needing a detailed playbook.

• You genuinely enjoy data. Large, messy datasets make you curious, and you’re willing to dig until you understand what is happening and what the business should do about it.

• You care deeply about operational quality. Data integrity, attribution, documentation, audience segmentation, and email deliverability aren’t afterthoughts—they’re part of building a trustworthy growth engine.

• You balance speed with judgment. You know when to move quickly, when a shortcut creates unacceptable downstream risk, and when to challenge an approach that won’t scale.

• You see AI as a way to amplify good judgment and increase leverage rather than a substitute for understanding the work.

• You communicate clearly in an async, distributed environment and can build alignment across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, RevOps, and Data without relying on organizational authority.

title: Marketing Automation Manager - Canada, Spain, India
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 Storyblok is hiring a Marketing Automation Manager to own the top of funnel systems and the campaigns that run through them: Pardot, the forms on the Storyblok website, list uploads, Clay, and the nurture programs, sequences and webinar flows built in Pardot. The role sends the campaigns, loads the lists and builds the forms day to day, and turns that repeat work into templates and automations so more of the week goes to lead scoring, routing, data quality and reporting. Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Demand Generation, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Operations and Analytics, in a lean data team where the person pulls their own numbers and builds their own reports.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Campaign operations

• Build and send list emails and sequences in Pardot and Knak: webinar invites and follow ups, quarterly enterprise and marketer sequences, review asks, partner and event emails.

• Build and run the nurture programs in Engagement Studio (welcome, post webinar, gated content, re-engagement), each by segment and lifecycle stage, and rebuild them as results come in.

• Set up webinars end to end: registration form, Zuddl to Pardot sync, campaign IDs, reminders and follow up. Build form handlers, autoresponders and landing page forms on the Storyblok website.

• Load lead lists from events, content syndication and paid social with the right campaign, source and consent, and run the request board: intake, SLA, QA before launch.

• Run optimization: Test subject lines, send times and content on every sequence, and personalise by segment, industry and stage.

• Marketing systems and integrations

• Administer Pardot and its Salesforce sync: users, connectors, field mapping, campaign member status.

• Own the links between Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Zuddl, Knak, Meta and Google Ads, and keep them documented.

• Run Clay: enrichment waterfalls, list building, and the signal tables that feed BDR routing.

• Evaluate, buy and renew the marketing tools.

• Lead flow, scoring and routing operations

• Own lead scoring and grading, reviewed each quarter against what converts.

• Own lifecycle stages (MQL, SAL, SQL) and the handoff rules to BDRs and AEs.

• Bring self serve signups and product usage into scoring and lifecycle, so PLG and enterprise leads run through 1 flow.

• Data quality and reporting

• Own the sync between the warehouse, Pardot and Salesforce in both directions: enrichment and usage in, campaign results out.

• Keep the database clean: dedupe, normalise country, industry and title, suppression lists, GDPR consent by region.

• Own the campaign taxonomy and UTM standard across the team and agencies.

• Write your own SQL and Salesforce reports; build the funnel and pipeline by source reports in the BI tool. Watch deliverability: domain health, bounce and spam rates.

• Automation, process and cadence

• Template the repeat request types (list uploads, list emails, form handlers, webinar setups), then automate them with Clay, LLM tools (Claude) and a workflow builder such as n8n or Zapier, each with QA and a fallback.

• Write the playbooks and train marketers to self serve where it is safe.

• Own and report monthly on speed to lead, MQL to SQL and form to meeting rates, request turnaround and share automated, database coverage and accuracy, and email deliverability and engagement.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 4+ years in marketing operations or marketing automation, ideally in B2B SaaS.

• Pardot administration: Salesforce connector, Engagement Studio, form handlers, campaign sync. Salesforce fluency: campaigns, lead and contact fields, reports and dashboards.

• Built nurture programs and can show what they did to conversion.

• Ran a request queue at volume and cut the time per request with templates and automation; shipped automations with a workflow builder and LLM tools and kept them running.

• Lead scoring, lifecycle and routing experience, with results.

• Working SQL, and hands on with an enrichment tool such as Clay, ZoomInfo or Apollo.

• Knowledge of GDPR and consent management across regions.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

 PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

• Operating discipline: runs a high volume request queue on an SLA with QA before every launch.

• Systems thinking: sees how Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Clay and the warehouse connect, and keeps the data flowing cleanly between them.

• Data fluency: pulls own numbers, defines fields and builds reports without an analyst in between.

• Automation mindset: templates repeat work, then builds the automation that removes it.

• Attention to detail: a wrong list or a broken form reaches thousands of people.

• Testing habit: runs tests on every sequence and changes the program based on results.

• Cross-functional coordination: aligns Demand Gen, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development and Sales Ops around 1 lead flow.

• Communication: writes clear playbooks and guidance that marketers follow without a meeting.

 At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.

title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
description:
At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year.

Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year.

The Marketing Team is empowered to spark change daily with MAP - Mastery in their role, Autonomy to make decisions, and a Purpose to make the world a safer place for all consumers. Using cutting-edge tech and delivering best-in-class content, they influence the trajectory of our company. It’s this team spirit and trust in each other that let us go further together. This team has two simple goals: 1. Everyone in the world knows about the Feedzai brand 2. Making sure our sales team is busy. Join Us!

We’re looking for a strategic, data‑driven Campaign Manager to architect, lead, and orchestrate Feedzai’s largest global marketing campaigns. Feedzai’s campaigns are the connective tissue between brand, product, and growth. As Campaign Manager, you’ll turn business priorities into clear campaign strategies, align cross-functional teams around the plan, and drive the programs that build awareness, generate demand and accelerate pipeline.

You:

You’re a strategic full-funnel marketer who knows how to turn business priorities into clear, measurable campaign strategies. You thrive in complex, fast-moving environments, bringing structure to ambiguity and momentum to cross-functional teams. You’re a natural orchestrator who can build alignment, drive accountability and confidently communicate with senior stakeholders. You stay close to performance, know how to spot what isn’t working, and bring the right teams together to fix it.

Your Day to Day:

  • Design and lead multi-channel, full-funnel campaigns tied to Feedzai’s strategic GTM motions and growth priorities.
  • Translate business priorities into clear campaign goals, audiences, messaging, buyer journeys, routes to market and success metrics.
  • Orchestrate teams across Product Marketing, Digital, Content, Comms, Creative, Regional Marketing, Partner Marketing, ADRs and Sales to deliver against one integrated campaign strategy.
  • Identify critical gaps in audience, market intelligence, positioning, product readiness or sales follow-up and work with the right stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, buyer insights and product priorities into differentiated full-funnel messaging.
  • Stay close to campaign, lead and pipeline performance, working with Digital, ADRs and Sales to quickly identify issues and optimize messaging, targeting, channels and follow-up.
  • Build campaign enablement that gives Sales and ADR teams the messaging, content and outreach guidance needed to convert engagement and accelerate pipeline.
  • Lead campaign reviews, clearly communicating performance, learnings, risks, recommendations and next steps.
  • Manage multiple complex campaigns at once, bringing structure, accountability and momentum in a fast-moving environment.

You Have & You Know‑How:

  • 8–10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience leading integrated or demand generation campaigns in SaaS, fintech or enterprise technology.
  • Proven ability to translate business priorities into clear, measurable full-funnel campaign strategies that drive pipeline and revenue impact.
  • Deep understanding of B2B marketing fundamentals, including audience segmentation, ICPs, positioning, buyer journeys, demand generation and pipeline acceleration.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive execution across teams you do not directly manage.
  • Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple complex initiatives, teams and deadlines.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the confidence to clearly articulate strategy, recommendations and performance to senior leaders.
  • A data-driven mindset, comfortable analyzing campaign and pipeline performance and translating insights into action.
  • Strong marketing judgment, with the ability to identify missing inputs, ask the right questions and keep work moving forward.
  • A self-starter with a bias for action who thrives in high-pressure environments where priorities can change and complete information may not always be available.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, fraud, financial crime, payments, banking technology or enterprise financial services strongly preferred.

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

title: HR Business Partner
description:
At University Schools Trust, we know that great schools are built by great people.

We're looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to join our People Directorate and play a key role in supporting our schools, leaders and colleagues to deliver outstanding education for children and young people across East London.

This is not a traditional HR role focused solely on policy advice or administration.

As the HR professional for a portfolio of schools, you will work closely with Headteachers, Principals and senior leaders, providing strategic challenge, expert advice and hands-on support across the full range of people matters. From leading complex employee relations cases and organisational change programmes to supporting workforce planning and leadership development, you'll be a trusted adviser who helps leaders navigate challenges and make informed decisions.

If you're looking for a role where you can influence organisational culture, support leaders through difficult conversations, and help shape the future of schools, we'd love to hear from you.

As HR Business Partner, you will be responsible for delivering both strategic and operational HR support across your allocated schools.

You'll work autonomously, managing a varied and often complex workload, while collaborating closely with colleagues across the wider People Team.

No two days are the same.

One day you may be coaching a Headteacher through a sensitive employee relations matter; the next you could be supporting a school restructure, analysing workforce trends, delivering management training or advising on succession planning and organisational development.

This role requires excellent professional judgement, resilience, credibility and the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking an experienced HR professional who understands both the strategic and operational aspects of people management.

You'll likely have experience as:

  1. HR Business Partner
  2. Senior HR Advisor
  3. HR Manager
  4. Employee Relations Specialist
  5. Senior People Partner

Ideally within education, public sector, not-for-profit or similarly complex environments, although we welcome applicants from other sectors who can demonstrate transferable experience.

This role is rewarding, challenging and occasionally demanding.

You'll need to be comfortable having difficult conversations, making balanced professional judgements and supporting leaders through complex workforce issues.

In return, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference, influence organisational culture and help create environments where both staff and pupils can thrive.

The successful candidates will work collaboratively with teachers and curriculum leaders to identify barriers to learning, model effective inclusive strategies, provide developmental coaching, evaluate the impact of interventions on learner engagement and deliver intervention sessions to identified groups of learners. They will contribute to the continuous improvement of teaching, learning and assessment by promoting evidence-informed approaches and supporting the implementation of the college's inclusive teaching and learning strategy.

This is an exciting opportunity for experienced practitioners with a strong understanding of SEND, inclusive pedagogy and effective professional development to influence practice across the organisation and make a lasting difference to the educational experiences and outcomes of our learners.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in shaping inclusion across the college. You will have the chance to influence teaching and learning at scale, work alongside talented colleagues, and make a tangible difference to the lives and outcomes of young people.

If you are passionate about inclusion and believe every learner deserves the opportunity to succeed, we would love to hear from you.
