title: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://www.workiva.com/latam/

 Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.

 This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.

 You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

 What you’ll do

• Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.

• Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.

• Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.

• Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.

• Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.

• Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.

• Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.

• Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.

• Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

 What you’ll need

 Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.

• Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

 Preferred Qualifications

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.

• Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.

• Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.

• Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.

• A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.

• Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.

• Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.

• Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

 Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers

• Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments

 How You’ll Be Rewarded

 ✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

 ✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

 ✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

 ✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

 The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

 Why Join Workiva

 Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

 At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

 Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

 Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email talentacquisition@workiva.com .

 Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

 Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

title: Manager II, Developer Advocacy
description:
Headquarters: California, USA, Remote; New York, USA, Remote; Washington, USA, Remote

 Developer Advocates at Datadog are engineers who share their expertise with technical practitioners, help customers tell their stories, and represent the perspectives of our community inside Datadog.

 As a Manager II on the Advocacy team, you will lead our Community Advocacy functions. You will manage a team of Developer Advocates responsible for global programs such as Datadog Ambassadors, Champions, and User Groups, as well as opportunities for customer engineers to share their expertise through technical writing, public speaking, and other community contributions.

Across these interconnected programs, your team will enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, lead communities, and turn their experiences into compelling content and conference talks for Datadog and third-party channels. This role combines people leadership, program strategy, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence to amplify authentic customer voices, deepen understanding of Datadog and its products, and foster a thriving community of practitioners.

 What You’ll Do:

• Lead and develop a team of Developer Advocates, setting clear expectations, guiding priorities, coaching performance, supporting career growth, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture

• Own the strategy, goals, and roadmap for Community Advocacy, translating broader Advocacy and company priorities into focused programs and measurable outcomes

• Guide the continued development of our Ambassador, Champion, and User Group programs, creating clear contributor journeys, expectations, enablement, recognition, and opportunities for customer engineers to increase their impact

• Build repeatable systems that enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, create content, share best practices, and serve as trusted leaders within their communities

• Develop a strong pipeline of customer stories by identifying compelling practitioners and helping them shape authentic, technically credible narratives

• Oversee the support, co-development, and coaching of conference talks by customer engineers—from identifying an idea and developing an abstract through content review, rehearsal, and delivery—for Datadog events, including our flagship user conference, DASH, as well as third-party industry conferences

• Establish measures of success for Community Advocacy, using qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate program health, contributor engagement, content quality, audience impact, and customer outcomes

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives

• Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products

• Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

 Who You Are:

• You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans

• You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions

• You have built or meaningfully contributed to programs that enable external practitioners to participate, contribute, create content, or lead communities at scale

• You have experience helping technical practitioners develop and communicate their stories, including coaching conference speakers or co-developing technically credible talks and content

• You are a former software developer, SRE, or other technical practitioner—or have equivalent technical depth—with the judgment needed to assess technical accuracy and coach effective technical narratives

• You are a thoughtful cross-functional leader who can build alignment, make prioritization decisions, and influence partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, and customer-facing organizations

• You use both data and community insight to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities, and make decisions about where the team should invest

• You understand how to build trust with technical communities and value authentic practitioner voices over purely promotional messaging

• You are comfortable operating through ambiguity, establishing structure where needed, and evolving programs as Datadog’s products, customers, and technical audiences grow

 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth:

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

• Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions

• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

• Competitive global benefits

 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Senior Customer Engineer - Collibra Public Sector
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

 J oining Collibra’s Public Sector team

 The Federal Customer Engineer (CE) serves as the guiding force behind bringing Collibra Public Sector's (CPS) product and vision to customers and prospects. Senior Customer Engineers are responsible for both net-new and expansion opportunities in existing accounts. They establish knowledgeable and trusted relationships from day one and serve as thoughtful technical advisors. The CE maintains a technical relationship with customers throughout the entire customer journey, both pre- and post-sale. You will fill an essential and highly respected role in the sales organization at CPS.

 As a Federal Customer Engineer at Collibra Public Sector, you will support our nation’s most critical agencies in achieving Data Sovereignty and Mission Intelligence . You will partner with Federal Account Executives to navigate the unique procurement and technical landscapes of the DoW, Civilian and the Intelligence Community agencies. Your goal is to show how Collibra’s Self-Hosted and FedRAMP-authorized platforms can break down agency silos, ensure regulatory compliance, and accelerate the secure adoption of AI.

 Senior Customer Engineers at Collibra are responsible for

 Presales

• Lead in-depth technical discovery sessions to uncover complex needs and environments and recommend solutions

• Owns delivery of technical evaluation efforts with input from specialists for (Data Quality, Privacy, AI Governance and the core Collibra Platform).

• Works closely with the Account Executive to craft win-win sales proposals and influence decisions.

• Participates in discovery and drives qualification of new opportunities, and expands Collibra solutions with existing customers.

• Prepares and owns functional and technical sections of RFPs/RFQs.

 Demonstration/Presentation delivery

• Deliver focussed demonstration, creating sample/custom assets and configure workflows as required to meet client needs.

• Deliver focused presentations and roadmaps to key stakeholders across both business and technology

• Deliver complex tailored demonstrations and discuss in detail customization capabilities for specific use cases.

• Present tailored product roadmap presentation based on customer's priorities and current/future use cases

• Deliver complex multi-disciplinary workshops from start to finish involving internal and external stakeholders.

• Lead and own workshops, be the key driver for the agenda, and ensure outcomes result in positive outcomes for client and Collibra.

• Lead product and technical sections of regular business reviews with key customers

• Prepare and conduct product demonstrations, highlighting how Collibra’s Platform can support our Federal Government customer requirements.

• Identifying, evaluating, recommending, and executing value-based workshops and proof of concepts/values.

• Deliver tailored demonstrations that address specific Federal mandates (e.g., OMB M-24-10 regarding AI Governance, CDO Council priorities, and Executive Orders on Data Sharing).

• Lead technical Proof of Value (PoV) engagements within agency environments.

• Ensure successful deployment of Collibra Edge behind agency firewalls.

 Relationship Management

• Acts as the technical authority on Collibra’s security posture, including FedRAMP (Moderate), IL4/IL5 requirements, and SOC2 compliance.

• Acts as a liaison between the client and internal teams on complex requirements and issues that need clarification.

• Leads complex evaluation efforts, coordinating cross-functional resources, and complex testing scenarios.

• Document customer use cases and value realized (or to be realized for new) leveraging value consulting team where relevant.

• Proactively engages with senior-level and strategically important customer/prospect representatives, influencing product-related decisions.

• Develops executive-level credibility and trust, influencing customer-focused solution development and purchasing decisions.

• Build independent relationships to identify growth opportunities.

• Act as a go-to subject matter expert for specific product areas, industries, or complex technical domains.

 Adoption and Expansion

 Customer Support

 You have

• Proficiency in SQL and deep familiarity with Federal data stacks (e.g., Snowflake Government Data Cloud, AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and Palantir) are a plus.

• Working knowledge of NIST 800-53, FISMA, and the Federal Data Strategy.

• Proven ability to navigate the Federal procurement cycle and build long-term relationships with Agency CDOs, CTOs, and Program Managers.

• Experience should include a broad range of disciplines, including value-based selling, cost-benefit analysis, ROI analysis, process and project management.

• Experience in regulatory compliance and or (financial/IT) audit is a plus.

• Experience working with leading PaaS providers, data lakes, databases, and integration platforms is required.

• Familiarity in enterprise security solutions such as LDAP or Kerberos.

• Experience working with Data Quality, Data Pipelines, Data Orchestration, and/or Job Control tools.

• Knowledgeable of at least least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management

• Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies

• Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.

title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 About the Role

 As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

 Key Responsibilities

• Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

• Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

• Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

• Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

• QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

• Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

• Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

• Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

• Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

• Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

 Qualifications

 Required

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

• Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

• Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

• Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

• A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

• Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

• Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

• Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

 Preferred

• Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

• Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

• Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

• Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

• Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

• Agency or consulting experience.

 Why Current

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

 This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
description:
Headquarters: U.S. Remote

 About Flexport:

 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

 What you'll do

 There is no MSSP and no tier-1 queue here. Detection & Response engineers own their detections end to end: you write them, you tune them, and your team is paged when they fire. The security team is spread across the globe with a follow-the-sun pager rotation so nobody is paged at 3am local.

 The adversaries are real. The business is growing fast and the threat surface is growing with it. Defining the necessary telemetry is part of the job.

 Detection engineering

• Build and tune detections across endpoint, identity, SaaS, and cloud , treating them as software: version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and shipped through the same CI/CD practices the rest of engineering uses.

• Track detection quality as measured quantities : coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, precision, time-to-detect. We don’t build-and-forget here.

 Response & automation

• Own incident response: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective that turns the incident into a systemic fix.

• Build automation that removes toil from investigations, and partner closely with the US-based team so context carries across time zones instead of getting lost at handoff.

 Telemetry & partnership

• Define telemetry requirements for new systems before they ship , working with infrastructure and product teams to close visibility gaps rather than discovering them during an incident.

• Threat hunt proactively across the estate , converting hypotheses into either new detections or documented coverage.

 You Should Have

• Typically 5–8 years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with real hands-on time writing and tuning detections. We care more about what you've built than the exact number.

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) and comfort writing production-grade detection and automation code.

• Experience with a modern SIEM or detection pipeline (Panther, Elastic, Splunk, or similar). What matters is that you've shipped and tuned detection logic in production.

• Practical incident response experience : you've led or played a major role in triaging and closing out real security incidents.

 Nice to have

• Experience treating detections as code with CI/CD, peer review, and staged rollout.

• Experience defining telemetry contracts for systems before they ship, rather than retrofitting logging after an incident.

• A track record of critically evaluating and verifying AI-assisted work - testing, source-checking, validation - rather than trusting agent output by default. If you haven’t already spotted the em dashes in this job description and already thought about where the hiring manager (hi!) has put hands on keyboard and compared that to where they let the LLM watermarks through, you might not be the right person for the job.

• Familiarity with cloud-native and Kubernetes telemetry.

• Experience with fraud or financial-crime detection patterns.

 How we work

• We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs.

• We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.

• We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

 Why this role is special

• You own your detections end to end, no MSSP, no tier-1 queue, no handing your work to someone else to triage.

• The consequences here are physical, not abstract: a containment decision can stop a customs filing or freight actually moving, which makes the stakes concrete in a way a SaaS control plane rarely is.

• You'll inherit a real, established estate with legacy telemetry gaps to close, genuinely underexplored surface area, not a well-mined problem.

title: Client Enablement Lead
description:
Headquarters: New York City, Remote

 Alloy is where you belong!

 Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces , Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers , Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us here .

 About the team

 Alloy’s platform is complex and managed with high-touch support from Alloy’s Technical Solutions team. Customers that would like to ‘self-serve’ often struggle to build a clear mental model of how Alloy works and why, falling back to Alloy’s support teams to complete even simple tasks. Today, enablement is spread across multiple repositories and handled one-to-one by delivery teams, with inconsistent results. Only a handful of sophisticated and adventurous clients currently achieve a moderate amount of self-sufficiency.

 This leader owns customer enablement across Alloy. This is not a technical writing role. It is a role that builds and runs the program behind enablement: capturing knowledge continuously, packaging it for the right audience at the right moment, running hands-on customer training sessions, and measuring what works.

 The Customer Enablement Lead will report to the VP of Product Design. From within the Product team they will help fill gaps and challenging areas of the product while creating a powerful feedback loop between customers and designers to decrease those gaps and challenges over time. The Enablement Lead will form strong cross-functional connections with the Support, Delivery, Technical Success, Product Marketing, and Product Operations teams to ensure customers have a seamless and supported experience as they go live and as we release new features.

 Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week. This role is open to both local and remote candidates in the US.

 What you'll own

 The initial scope of work for this role will include:

 Close Critical Gaps

 Audit the current state. Evaluate and consolidate existing resources (API docs, help articles, the learning center, in-product help, and delivery-built guides). Work with cross-functional partners to create any missing documentation and “Customer 101” program material.

 Outcome : Our AI support bot can answer essentially any customer question. Our delivery teams can pull together the content they need to run tailored training sessions with their customers.

 Deliver the Alloy New Customer Enablement Program

 Focus on new Alloy customers and deliver scalable, deployable training and content for repeatable implementations. Structure material so clients can self-pace from foundational to advanced. Target key user personas so they learn the features critical to their respective day-to-day.

 Outcome : Clients understand and use what they bought, and are aware of what else Alloy offers. Additionally they know where to look for additional guidance via documentation, AI support chat, and other escalation channels.

 Build the Product Release Enablement Program

 When Alloy builds a material new feature or capability, map what each client segment and persona needs to know, when, and why, from pre-sales through go-live and ongoing use, and make it part of how products are sold, launched, and delivered.

 Outcome : a shared view of our friction points and what areas currently drag the most on our bottom line.

 Facilitate the Feedback Loop

 Collect feedback after every release, rollout, and training. Give Product, Design, and Delivery a shared view of where clients get stuck, and drive alignment on whether each gap is best solved by product, technical solutions, or enablement, including interim fixes.

 Outcome : Product, Design, and Delivery share one view of enablement gaps and who owns them. The design team gets critical insight continuously, addressing customer confusion directly in the product, helping reduce the surface area for documentation over time.

 Milestones

 30 Days

 Onboarding into Alloy, learning the product yourself, existing resource audit, gap analysis, start filling documentation gaps with SME and tooling support, and deliver a consolidation plan.

 60 Days

 Initial enablement ‘package’ in beta for first client feedback via early hands-on training sessions.

 90 days

 Initial enablement funnel for core segments deployed and documentation gap filling has demonstrated a measurable increase in AI support ticket resolution. Iteration on the enablement package incorporating early feedback.

 Six Months

 Enablement package is ‘production ready’ and universally rolled out (client-facing teams are ready to deliver training using the material). Feedback loop with product and design solidified. The product release enablement funnel is operational as part of new feature releases. Seeing measurable improvements in some areas of self-service and legacy support ticket theme avoidance.

 Who we’re looking for

 Must-haves:

• 7+ years in customer education, enablement, or training, including building a customer enablement program from the ground up.

• Experience enabling customers on a technical, API-driven B2B SaaS product, with the depth to learn complex workflows and teach them clearly.

• Strong live facilitation. You've run hands-on training sessions with customers and adapted them in the room.

• A track record of tying enablement to measurable outcomes such as ticket deflection, adoption, or time to value.

• Experience influencing Product, Support, Delivery, and Marketing partners without direct authority.

• The judgment to tell when a customer problem needs content, a training, or a product fix, and the writing skills to make the case.

• Experience working inside a Product or Design organization.

title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

 Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI

 REMOTE, United States

 JOB OVERVIEW

 Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

 Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

 You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

 RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

 Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it.

 Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

 The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

 Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

 Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

 Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

 Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

 Design-partner delivery. Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke.

 TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS

 Legion is looking for a product manager who builds, rather than one who directs others who build. In a typical week, this role involves:

• Writing and iterating on prompts and system prompts directly, and explaining why a change improved a behavior

• Standing up a working prototype of a proposed agent — tool definitions, structured outputs, retries, guardrails — before engineering is asked to build anything

• Using agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) daily: prototyping, data analysis, specification work, and reading the codebase behind your specifications

• Reviewing an execution trace and diagnosing whether a failure originates in a tool description, a retrieval gap, a context-window constraint, an under-specified output schema, or a genuine model limitation

• Building and running evaluation sets, and interpreting the results without a data scientist to translate them

• Holding an informed position on retrieval design, tool-use patterns, structured output, model routing, latency and cost trade-offs, and multi-tenant safety in enterprise SaaS

• Opening pull requests against our codebase — a prototype, a prompt change, an evaluation fixture, a specification stub. Pushing code is permitted and actively encouraged for product managers who want to work that way. It is not a requirement of the role, and the same review standards apply to everyone.

• Following model releases, agent frameworks, and protocol changes, and translating them into roadmap implications within days rather than quarters

 We recognize that this is a demanding technical bar for a product role. It reflects what the work actually requires.

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years in product management (Senior) or 10+ years (Principal), including at least 2 years shipping LLM-backed features to external, paying users — not internal tools, proofs of concept, or hackathon projects

• Demonstrated hands-on capability of the kind described above. Expect to show your work.

• Substantial enterprise B2B SaaS experience: multi-tenant architecture, role-based access control, audit trails, single sign-on, data residency, security review, and enterprise procurement. You should be able to anticipate what a customer's security questionnaire will ask about an LLM feature.

• A record of taking an ambiguous, operationally complex domain problem through to a shipped product with demonstrated adoption — not only launch

• Evidence of staying with a product through implementation and owning its quality at release. We will ask about a release you delayed or stopped, what you found, and how you found it.

• The judgment to recognize what current models cannot do reliably, and the willingness to say so when a room expects a different answer

• Comfort working inside a codebase. An engineering background is not required, but you should be able to read the code behind what you are specifying, run it locally, and open a pull request.

• Strong written communication. Legion runs on documents, and candidates are evaluated substantially on how they write.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

• Direct experience in workforce management, HCM, ERP, supply chain, or another operationally complex enterprise domain with compliance exposure

• Familiarity with labor compliance regimes — predictive scheduling ordinances, meal and rest break rules, union work rules — or demonstrated ability to become fluent in a comparable regulatory domain quickly

• Background in demand forecasting, optimization, or decision systems

• Experience building platform or authoring surfaces that customers configure themselves

• An engineering or technical degree, or prior experience as an engineer or data scientist

• Experience with products sold into frontline-heavy industries: retail, hospitality, healthcare, or manufacturing

 SCOPE OF ROLE, STATED PLAINLY

 So that candidates can assess fit early:

• This is an individual contributor role. There is no team to inherit and no management responsibility at present.

• The role is accountable for what ships, not for what is specified. Writing the specification is a portion of the work, not the whole of it.

• This is not an AI strategy or vendor-evaluation role. The work is product definition, prototyping, specification, evaluation, and delivery.

• The role requires forming an independent point of view from operational research. Direction will not be handed down in detail.

• The environment carries genuine ambiguity. The category is being defined as we work in it, and model capabilities shift underneath the roadmap.

 SELECTION PROCESS

 Our process includes a practical exercise: a sanitized workforce management problem, for which candidates produce an agent design — scope, tools, failure modes, human-in-the-loop contract, and evaluation plan — together with a working prototype they built themselves, using any model provider they prefer. The exercise is then discussed with the people the candidate would work alongside. We weigh it heavily, and we compensate candidates for the time.

 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 Salary Range: $280,000-$300,000 +bonus (tied to business outcomes) +Stock Equity

 At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

 Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company.

 Benefits include, but are not limited to:

• $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment

• 401k plan

• Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• Parental Leave

• Equity

• Monthly Wellness Reimbursement

• Monthly Lunch on Legion

 ABOUT LEGION

 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

 Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

 BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US

 PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 We are seeking a technical and customer-focused Solutions Consultant to join our team . The Solutions Consultant will be responsible for understanding customer business environments, actively identifying potential roadblocks, and providing thoughtful solutions that leverage PagerDuty’s products . They will run the technical discovery process and provide guidance, relationship-building, and support throughout the sales process to ensure customer success .

 As a Solutions Consultant at PagerDuty, you’ll sit at the nexus between pre-sales, sales, and customer experience and success . You are an extraordinary partner who plays the part of consultant, technical salesperson, technical guru, product specialist, and teacher, with a committed dedication to exceptional customer service . You will build strong, significant, and compassionate relationships with internal and external partners at all levels while helping customers realize and optimize PagerDuty's capabilities .

 Key responsibilities

• Actively identify potential roadblocks and provide thoughtful, technical solutions

• Run technical discovery processes to understand customer environments and potential technical landmines

• Design integrations to provide seamless implementation with the customer's current technology stack

• Support sales cycles by handling technical questions in RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires

• Break down complex technical concepts and clearly articulate PagerDuty's business value to stakeholders from DevOps engineers up to C-level executives

• Support one of our over 375+ native integrations to help customers realize and optimize PagerDuty's capabilities

• Partner with sales, product, and cross-functional teams with a focus on growth and exceptional customer service

• Manage multiple tasks independently and collaboratively using project management and account management skills

• Come up to speed quickly, learn continuously, and apply impeccable attention to detail to all tasks

 Basic qualifications

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

 About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

 We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

 Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 Our Core Technologies

 Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 What You'll Do

 • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

 • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

 • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

 • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

 • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

 • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

 • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

 • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

 • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

 • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

 • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 What We Look For:

 • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

 • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

 • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

 • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

 • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

 • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

 • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

 • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 Nice To Have:

 • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

 • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

 • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

 • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

 • Conversation design or UX writing experience

 What We Offer You:

 • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

 • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

 • Flexible PTO

 • Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

 • Health & wellness initiatives

We are seeking a Privacy Compliance Associate to join our Data Governance & AI Non-Financial Risk team, supporting Morgan Stanley in meeting its privacy and data protection obligations. The role will work across business lines to help ensure global Data Subject Rights requests, including access and erasure requests, are managed appropriately and responded to within required timeframes.

In the Legal & Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Associate level position within the Privacy Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team who are part of the second line of defence, governing and overseeing data subject rights requests and privacy across the Firm.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you'll do in the role:

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm when responding to Data Subject Rights requests, including data subject access requests (DSARs) and erasure requests, within statutory deadlines.

- Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm with the intake, processing, redactions and quality assurance checks of request responses.

- Support Privacy NFR with oversight activity including monitoring of dashboards and production of metrics for reporting to colleagues, partners and governance groups.

- Support Privacy NFR by providing advice and guidance on global Data Subject Rights to key stakeholders across the Firm.

- Enhance policies, procedures, processes, reporting, training and support ad-hoc projects as required.

- Ability to collaborate and partner with cross-functional teams, business units and individuals at all levels.

- Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Proactive work ethic and team player mindset.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A passion for data protection and privacy.

At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role.

title: Staff Prototyping Engineer, Android
location: Flexible / Remote, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Slack

Slack is your Digital HQ - bringing people, apps, customers, and AI agents together in one place. Millions of people use Slack every day to communicate, collaborate, and get work done. As work becomes increasingly distributed and AI-powered, Slack is redefining how teams operate and achieve at scale. In this AI era, Slack's mission remains making people's work lives simpler, more pleasant, and more productive.

The Team

The Slack Mobile team builds Slack's mobile experiences, from core messaging to AI and everything in between.

We operate at the intersection of product innovation, mobile platform excellence, and large-scale engineering. The features and systems we build support millions of daily users and require deep investments in performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience.

The Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to help shape the future of Slack's mobile product. As a Prototyping Engineer, you'll embed as a leader on greenfield, zero-to-one initiatives. You'll influence product and design direction through engineering work that builds and ships the first versions of newly-imagined, fully working product features. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and fellow mobile engineers to help innovate some of the biggest new product opportunities for Slack, with experiences that are intuitive, performant, and reliable for millions of users worldwide.

What You'll Do

This is a role for a self-directed, creative engineer who can operate with high velocity and strong independent judgment, combining hands-on technical leadership with broad organizational influence. We are looking for someone who can start from an ambiguous problem, no defined path, and competing priorities, and work through that to frame the problem, align stakeholders on what matters most, and move quickly from idea to working prototype to a shipped experience. You will:

  • Shape the future of Slack on mobile by leading the engineering development of experiences used by millions of users every day, spanning multiple teams and the broader organization.
  • Lead the most complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from early technical exploration through production rollout and long-term evolution.
  • Lead feature prototyping to define the mobile user experience for Slack's biggest opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to shape experiences that balance user needs, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team through technical leadership, product reviews, and mentorship.
  • Set and evangelize best practices for mobile feature development and operational excellence across the broader engineering organization.
  • Mentor senior engineers and contribute to the growth of the broader mobile engineering community within Slack.
  • A related technical degree required.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building complex, high-craft Android applications at scale.
  • Proven track record of moving outside of organizational boundaries to start new initiatives, prototype the path to production, and reorient the organization to support the new initiative.
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, whether at a start-up, in an incubator, or on a zero-to-one team inside a larger enterprise.
  • Proven track record of leading large, ambiguous, org-spanning technical initiatives with significant business impact.
  • Deep expertise in Kotlin framework and modern Android development.
  • Strong understanding of Android architecture, application lifecycle, concurrency, networking, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence product and technical direction through expertise and collaboration, driving alignment across executive stakeholders, Engineering/Product/Design leadership, and multiple teams.
  • A bias toward ownership, execution, and continuous improvement, with the judgment to prioritize the highest-leverage work across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture patterns. Experience with Kotlin coroutines, and dependency injection frameworks (e.g. Metro, Dagger).
  • Experience leading large-scale new products, features, or product transformations spanning multiple teams or the whole org.
  • Experience using research, usability testing, data, and experimentation to ground decisions and uncover opportunities.
  • Contributions to open source projects or the Android community, or other external recognition of technical leadership.
  • Experience building collaboration, productivity, messaging, AI, or enterprise software products.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong product intuition and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $197,300 - $313,700 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $237,700 - $344,700 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

 Equal Opportunities :

 About Jumio:

 Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

 Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

 Applicant Data Privacy

title: Logistics Analyst, Soho Home
description:
The Role..

Our Logistics Analyst will gather and interrogate data to make decisions that protect cost, service and brand experience across Soho Home's UK, EU and US operations. This role is a combination of ‘business as usual’ report optimisation and new report creation/automation. The successful candidate will lead analysis across delivery partners and 3PLs building models and reports to present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders. This role reports to the Director of Operations & Systems and will work very closely with the Head of Operations day to day. 

Key responsibilities..

Strategic analysis and modelling

  • Build a suite of logistics reports to better support ‘business as usual’ and inform decision-making
  • Model the cost and service impact of pricing changes, service propositions, and expansion options
  • Quantify the operational and cost impact of distribution changes, such as tariffs, compliance and product data requirements

Commercial control

  • Delivery of cost-to-serve by market and by channel 
  • Lead invoice audits against contracted rates across regions
  • Identify and size cost saving opportunities, and track savings delivered.

Partner performance 

  • Own the KPI framework for partners: on-time-in-full, first-time delivery success, damages, claims and returns processing.
  • Prepare monthly & quarterly business review packs and evidence SLA breaches for escalation.
  • Benchmark costs and data across freight & warehousing 

Capacity planning

  • Track warehousing capacity globally to identify risks and opportunities

Reporting, data and systems

  • Create logistics dashboards for the team and senior stakeholders
  • Act as the bridge between operations and systems on reporting and systems requirements.

Skills and experience

  • Demonstrable experience in logistics analysis, ideally in Retail or eCommerce
  • Advanced Excel, including modelling, Power Query and pivot analysis
  • Advanced Power BI skills
  • Working knowledge of multi-market operations, including customs and duty basics

 

Benefits…

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to grow your career.

  • Annual Every House Membership
  • 50% off Food & Drink, 7 days a week
  • Staff Room Rates
  • Private Health and Dental Care
  • Weekly Pay
  • Life Assurance
  • Up to 50% Staff Discount on Cowshed & Soho Home
  • In Office Dog Policy on Fridays
  • Season Ticket Loan
  • Christmas Office Closure
  • In conjunction with Soho Impact, take 2 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice.
  • Free Counselling Sessions
  • Cookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & House Tonic programmes offer unique food and drink trainings, events and opportunities to inspire and educate.
  • Continuous training to develop yourself personally and professionally
  • Exclusive access to our benefits platform with hundreds of discounts on shopping, gym memberships, holidays, insurance and much more
  • Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to

title: Site Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 About Vercel:

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

 About the Role:

 As a growth-focused Fullstack Engineer on our team, you will play a central role in driving user acquisition, conversion, and retention through highly performant and visually stunning web experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams—from marketing to sales to product design—to build dynamic pages, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

 In this role, you’ll design and develop scalable features that enhance the user journey, integrate feedback loops, monitor key metrics, and ensure the reliability of our acquisition funnel. By staying updated on industry trends and focusing on delightful UX, you’ll continuously refine our web properties—ultimately delivering an exceptional experience from first touch through ongoing engagement.

 If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

 What You Will Do:

• Lead complex frontend projects that establish Vercel as a gold standard for brand and product marketing.

• Collaborate with growth and marketing teams to A/B test landing pages for lead generation across multiple channels.

• Design and implement scalable applications, web services, and APIs with a focus on user experience and performance.

• Contribute to our design system and uphold industry-leading UX standards (e.g., interactions, micro-animations, layout consistency).

• Continuously improve engineering processes, tools, and systems to scale the codebase and team productivity.

• Troubleshoot and fix bugs, delivering quick, high-quality resolutions.

• Write technical documents and maintain internal tools to empower other teams.

• Review and provide feedback on contributions from other engineers.

• Identify bottlenecks and optimize for conversion, speed, and reliability across the funnel.

• Critically think about foundational areas of the Vercel application to ensure ease of maintenance and future extensibility.

 About You:

• 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience (React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, or similar).

• Strong proficiency in Next.js and familiarity with modern frontend frameworks.

• Full stack experience (comfortable designing or consuming APIs and working with various services).

• Deep understanding of SEO principles and best practices—especially around performance, accessibility, and search optimization.

• Proven knowledge of A/B testing concepts and conversion rate optimization.

• Stellar cross-functional communication skills—you can work effectively with marketing, design, and product to reach shared goals.

• Eye for good user experiences and a knack for “getting the visuals right.”

• Desire to work in a fast-paced environment, continuously grow, and master your craft.

 Bonus If You:

• Have familiarity with the Vercel platform.

• Comfortable using Tailwind CSS.

• Background in web design or interest in design systems.

• Interest in developer tooling domain.

 Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $196,000 - $294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

 Disclosures:

• Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

title: Research Data Expert
location: London, United Kingdom, New York, NY, Singapore
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities
  • Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.
